text: Privacy Policy
Last updated: March 2026
We care about your privacy. This policy explains what data Divizion Launcher collects and how it is used.
Our principle
Divizion Launcher is designed to respect your privacy. We do not collect personally identifiable data. No sensitive information is stored on our servers.
Google Analytics
The launcher uses Google Analytics with our own custom tags. These data are used exclusively for internal statistics, not advertising.
We only measure the number of launcher and instance launches
No personal or identifiable data is collected
Statistics are fully anonymized
No user profile is created
No targeted advertising is shown
Discord RPC
The launcher supports Discord RPC (Rich Presence) to display your Minecraft activity on your Discord profile. This feature is optional and can be disabled in settings.
Communication takes place only between your computer and Discord
No data is sent to our servers
You retain full control of this feature
Local data
Your game data, configurations and instances are stored exclusively on your computer. Nothing is synchronized or sent to external servers without your explicit consent.
Third-party services
The launcher may interact with third-party services in order to function correctly:
Mojang / Microsoft for Minecraft authentication, only when you use an official account
Modrinth, CurseForge and other platforms for downloading mods and modpacks
GitHub for launcher updates
Your control
You can disable anonymous statistics and Discord RPC at any time in the launcher settings.
Changes
This privacy policy may be updated occasionally. Changes will be announced through the launcher or our GitHub.
